method: Existing GUI tree stop checks recorded PID/path/creation; model supervisors retain native owned handles and recheck image/creation before terminating. Broker/sampler stop by their own isolated markers. Final PID liveness and socket checks. No user app or operational listener stopped.
model_stop_code_1: Requested test shutdown on Windows, not memory pressure or model quality failure.
webview_limit: Port/tree shutdown verified by the existing owned-tree script; not enumeration of unrelated WebViews.
